comment: Single source of truth for how the skills, agents and required sources in this package relate, AND for the live state those relationships are gated on. The per-category 'Bound edges' tables in each INDEX.md are RENDERED from this file, and tools/check_plugin.py fails the build when they drift. Edit this file, then re-run the checker, or it will tell you exactly which table is stale.

state._comment: Live state, declared here and read through its own tool. The graph does not store the values - it points at the readers - so it cannot drift from reality. Read it all with kaggle_presence action='status', which reports the graph state and the ask-or-auto answer together. Anything unreadable fails toward asking: the cost of a wrong 'ask' is a pause, the cost of a wrong 'auto' is an unattended irreversible action.

presence.meaning: whether the user is at the keyboard or has stepped away

effect.present: ask early and often; a question is cheap here and a wrong assumption can waste a 12h run
effect.away: take conservative, reversible, recorded defaults; ask only for irreversible or externally visible actions

search-engine.meaning: which engine a DISCOVERY search uses when nobody is available to be asked
gates: discovery search only; direct navigation to a known URL never asks

effect.present: ask the user which engine, then apply it
effect.away: use the configured default and record the choice

divisionOfLabour._comment: Skills that two mechanisms legitimately both touch, and exactly who decides what. ModularRSI found that jointly evolving its five modules scored 44.19% against 52.43% for evolving them independently and integrating: Agent Loop and validation each learned a completion judgement, and combined they produced two gates that blocked each other until timeout. Declaring the split is the fix - deleting an edge would only hide the overlap. tools/check_plugin.py refuses a duplicated claim with no entry here, and refuses an entry whose owners do not decide distinct things.

owners.decides: whether to ask the user at all, and to auto-decide on a recorded default when they are away
whether the settled choice is rendered as the account picker or answered in text - never whether to ask
whether to ask about engine and time limit, and what conservative default to take unattended
whether an engine picker is warranted once the decision exists; it has no widget yet, so it answers in text
whether a terminal state auto-advances to the next tree node or is reported and waited on
whether the fetch interval is rendered as the slider or settled in text
whether a handoff is drafted unattended; pushing to a remote is never auto-decided in either mode
whether the destination is offered as a picker; no visualizer exists yet, so it is text

edgeTypes.needs: This skill cannot do its job without the other one. The other is a prerequisite, not a suggestion.
edgeTypes.dispatches: This skill launches the other one at runtime (a subagent task, a follow-on skill, or an external skill) as part of its own procedure.
edgeTypes.produces: This skill's output is the other's input. This is the hand-off edge, and it is what makes the reading order a graph rather than a list.
edgeTypes.widget: The decision point in this skill is rendered by that visualizer. The business skill must emit the widget; the visualizer is the presentation, not the decision.
edgeTypes.gate: This skill decides whether that one warrants a widget at all. It is the only thing allowed to say 'no widget here'.
edgeTypes.browses: This skill MUST actually open and parse this source's own pages before its research counts as complete. The floor is about the source, not the tool: reading a known URL is done with web_fetch, and the in-app browser is reserved for discovery and for pages that genuinely need rendering or a signed-in session. A search-engine snippet, a cached summary, or a search result listing about the source does NOT satisfy this edge. This is the coverage floor, and it is enforced, not aspirational.
edgeTypes.asks: This skill decides whether the agent may auto-decide at the other skill's decision point, or must stop and ask the user. It is the only thing allowed to raise the ask threshold.
edgeTypes.enforces: A tool, not a convention: the named skill's core discipline is validated in code and a malformed record is refused. Prose can be skipped; this cannot. The shape is the floor, never the ceiling - what to try next stays the agent's judgement.
edgeTypes.loops: The cycle this edge describes is a read-then-decide cycle, and it is enforced by a gate rather than trusted to memory: a write is refused unless the reader saw the current state. Two records cannot happen back to back without an intervening read.

nodes.note: Built-in skill of the host runtime, not part of this package. Used for the general browser search, in the MAIN thread, over multiple rounds. It is also what a research node in the experiment tree goes back to.

Step 0 is the backend: doctor, then install numpy + matplotlib on the user's word, and only then draw. Step 1 is the figure contract - conclusion, archetype, panel map, evidence hierarchy, statistics, reviewer risk - written before any plotting code, because a figure nobody needed is an invitation to read a pattern into noise. Step 2 is action='analyze' for the six figures the tree has earned. The rest - honest encoding, redundant colour, explicit uncertainty and missing data, inspected exports - is vendored from K-Dense's scientific-visualization rather than written here, because a hand-rolled plotting guide is how the engine ended up asserting colourblind safety it had never measured.

Validated RSI DAG. Refuses a node with no hypothesis, no parent metric, an empty reason, no operator/method family, no recorded rank, a change containing a conjunction, a dangling parent, or a base with no artifacts. The one-variable rule is arithmetic, not wording: an experiment records the `factors` it switched on ([] is the bare model every other arm is measured against) and `controls` for seed/budget/eval/retrain, and the factor set must differ from its parent's by exactly one. A two-factor change needs factorsIntent='factorial', a zero-factor run needs factorsIntent='repeat', and controls that disagree with the parent need a confoundReason - the refusals are for silence, not for the answer. A declaration is an announcement, not an arm: a settled run is measured against whatever its declaration was measured against. Read-gated: record refuses a missing or stale readRevision. Also does non-greedy parent selection (quality+progress+novelty with visit cooling, per arXiv 2607.28568 sec 5.2) and an experience board attributing gain per operator.

Frontis-MA1 / OpenMLE. Source of the four atomic operators (draft/improve/debug/crossover) and the three-factor parent selection. Its matched comparison: Medal Average 53.03% -> 60.61% over score-greedy AIRA-Evo, same model, same 12h budget. Also the origin of the Human Rank convention recorded on every metric.

The Last AI Built by Humans. L1-L5 autonomy ladder and the three recurring RSI problems: safe inheritance, autonomy attribution, evaluator exploitation. The monotone selection guarantee is the direct answer to safe inheritance - persistence is not improvement.

Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds. Source of the replay simulator (a completed discovery history is walked to score alternative exploration policies at zero execution cost), the Eq.1 objective with its cost and parallelism terms, and the monotone selection that keeps the current policy in the candidate set. Its DAG departure is documented in the code.

Scaling Laws for Agent Harnesses via Effective Feedback Compute. EFC is the trajectory-level coordinate for feedback that is informative, valid, non-redundant and retained; raw tokens, tool calls, wall time and cost cannot distinguish useful feedback from redundant interaction. Judged per criterion here. (Note: some sources misattribute this arXiv id to an unrelated harness survey.)

ModularRSI. Carries the coupling finding that motivates divisionOfLabour: joint evolution of five modules scored 44.19% against 52.43% for independent evolution plus integration, because two completion gates blocked each other. Report-sourced figure; the mechanism it describes is the point.
The sources a research node may name. A research node goes back to one of these when a result made the current picture insufficient.

Chooses the engine for a DISCOVERY search. Its action='ask' reads the presence state itself, so the ask-or-auto decision is made by the tool rather than remembered by the agent. Direct navigation to a known URL is exempt and never asks.

The evidence store. Papers, repos, datasets and forum threads are stored once with the sentence that carries each claim, and tree nodes link to them with an explicit relation (supports / motivates / contradicts / supersedes). A node citing an id that is not in the store is rejected, so a typo cannot leave a link that silently resolves to nothing. action='doctor' reports whether the plotting backend (numpy + matplotlib) is importable and, when it is not, the exact command that installs it. It installs nothing without consent.

numpy + matplotlib plotting engine: line, band, bar, scatter, pareto, forest. The two packages are a prerequisite, not an extra, so a missing one is reported as `backend_missing` carrying the exact install command rather than as an ImportError. A dataset with no plottable point is refused and writes no file, and a point with no measurement becomes NaN so the line breaks instead of interpolating across the gap. The palette is the audited five-colour Okabe-Ito subset, not the full eight: two of those fall below 3:1 on white.

Adapted from experimental-design and uncertainty-and-units, MIT, pinned commit 1dd0fccf46fc3c9855c4a0c313a0c57fe4319883. Scripts deliberately not vendored: every one imports numpy/pandas/scipy/statsmodels/pyDOE3, none of which this plugin requires or may assume.

Vendored into skills/scientific-plotting/ from skills/scientific-visualization, MIT, read 2026-09-28: assets (5), references (5) and scripts (7), 187 KB. Unlike k-dense-methods the scripts ARE shipped here, because they are network-free and matplotlib-only. Kept mainly for scripts/palette_audit.py: run against this package's own palette it found 2 colours below WCAG 3:1 on white and 7 of 15 pairs colliding in greyscale - a claim the previous hand-written engine had asserted without ever measuring it. Adapted rather than copied verbatim: frontmatter flattened to this package's contract, a step 0 install gate added, action='analyze' made the entry point.

Host-bound in-app browser, used to open search pages and the required first-party sites. Session-scoped: a detached subagent does not have it, which is why the browsing happens in the main thread. Provided by the host, not registered by this package.

Publishes a release bundle as a Kaggle dataset and returns its URL. Reports the file count, total size and largest files before writing anything, because a git host refuses a large bundle and a dataset is the route that works. Writes outside, so it waits for a yes.

action='ablate' on kaggle_experiment_tree. Reads the recorded factor sets back and reports the comparison set rather than a table of remembered deltas: every edge isolating exactly one factor in whichever direction it was run, the interactions four DISTINCT arms make computable, the effects measured only alongside another factor, the arms whose controls disagree and therefore have no attributable delta, and the noise floor implied by any configuration run twice. It refuses to invent a baseline, to report an interaction from a degenerate triple where A+B is reachable as both the pair and a solo arm, and to attribute a delta across disagreeing controls.

a stored name has to change, not just be re-labelled
it renders that skill's decision point and owns no decision of its own
slug, leaderboard, forum and kernels-list all go through the CLI tools
the general search and the source forensics both run in the MAIN thread over multiple rounds, with no subagent dispatched anywhere in wave 2
the research is not complete until GitHub's own pages were opened and parsed, not merely quoted by a search engine
same floor for Hugging Face model and dataset pages
same floor for the arXiv listing and the paper pages themselves
the plan's constraints and open questions are what the fork/write call is judged against
the decision is only auditable if the evidence under it was gathered
a discovery search needs an engine, and the engine is a question until the presence state says otherwise
its 'ask' action reads the presence state, so the ask-or-auto decision is made by the tool rather than remembered by the agent
search pages and the three required sites are opened with the in-app browser, which only the main session has
quota, accelerator market state and the push itself
whose quota pays for this run is decided before anything is pushed
a run that produces logs is a run that needs watching
the first result is the first node of the tree
there has to be a live ref to poll and a terminal state to watch for
the fetch interval is a pending decision, so it is rendered, never guessed
it sets a value the subagent re-reads every cycle; it does not own the polling
an error or a terminal state is the observation a node records
a node without a run behind it is a claim, not an experiment
the base, its cost and the refuted set are read from the tree, never from recollection
the node shape is validated in code, so a missing hypothesis, an empty reason, a two-change 'and', a dangling parent or an unreproducible base is refused rather than written
record refuses a missing or stale readRevision, so the tree is read before every node: two records cannot happen back to back without an intervening read
a research node names the source it went back to, because a result made the current picture insufficient; the tool refuses a target outside this group
the four atomic operators, the three-factor parent selection and the Human Rank convention all come from here; it is why an operator and a rank are mandatory on every experiment node
the L1-L5 ladder explains which decisions the agent is allowed to take itself, and its three failure modes explain why refuted nodes are kept as evidence rather than deleted
the replay simulator is the reason the tree is archived into rounds: a completed history is walked to score alternative exploration policies without re-running anything
raw quota and wall time cannot tell useful feedback from redundant work, so the cost term is computed on effective feedback and judged per criterion
two mechanisms owning one decision point is the documented failure that cost ModularRSI eight points; divisionOfLabour is the guard
the skill defines what a node must mean; the tool is what makes that definition binding
a research node re-runs the same research sweep on purpose; re-reading the forum because a result told you to is the tree recording why
a completed run is a node, and the node cannot be written without first reading the tree
an unattended auto-advance records a node, and the read-gate is what keeps an overnight loop off a stale base
the document is derived from the tree so it cannot claim a base the tree lacks
the relay should reach another machine, and only then
it authenticates the transport for a handoff, and owns no handoff content
decides whether picking an account warrants a picker at all
decides whether the interval is a real pending decision
engine and accelerator are choices; the local slider has no widget yet, so that one answers in text
no widget row yet, so where the handoff goes is answered in text
picking which account is a cheap reversible call when the user is away, and a question when they are present
engine and time limit are auto-decided when away only within a stated, conservative cap; never past remaining quota
fork-vs-write defaults to the auditable path when away
a terminal state auto-advances to the next tree node when away, and reports when present
a handoff may be drafted unattended, but pushing it anywhere is never auto-decided
the two research agenda questions and the plan review are asked in either mode, so research stops and waits for them; between them research self-advances, and research decides what the questions ask
present: ask which engine for a discovery search. away: use the default and record it. Direct navigation to a known URL is exempt either way.
a question that is asked can be carried by a widget, so the two decide together and neither alone
the tree refuses a concluded node with no provenance, and this is how provenance is supplied - neither half works alone
a source is stored so a node can cite it; a store nobody cites is a reading list, not evidence
a score, a spread, a per-operator gain and a cost frontier are numbers a table cannot argue with; the figures are the analysis
every figure is drawn from the tree, and action='analyze' attaches each one back to the nodes it came from
one-variable nodes, honest replication and recorded cost are what make a kept node interpretable rather than merely true
it adapts design methodology to this tree's node shape; without the tree there is nothing for it to shape

designing the batch and reading what it established are two halves: this skill decides which arms to run and what to hold fixed, and the table reports the edges, the interactions four distinct arms make computable, the effects measured only alongside something else, and the arms whose controls disagree

action='ablate' is built from the recorded factor sets, not re-derived from prose: the primitive is an edge between two arms differing by exactly one factor, which is direction-free, so add-one-in and leave-one-out are the same edges read up or down
every paper and repo the sweep opened is stored once, so a later review can re-read it instead of re-searching
a node citing a source id that is not in the store is refused, so provenance can never dangle
action='analyze' turns the recorded samples and costs into figures, and reports every figure it could not draw rather than omitting it silently
it is an adaptation; the upstream bodies and their licence are recorded here so the provenance is not lost

its assets, references and scripts are vendored from there under MIT; deleting the node would leave a third-party licence with nothing pointing at it, and the palette audit that cleared this engine's colours lives in those scripts
the report is written from action='report' on that tree; every sentence traces to a row
the figures come from analyze, and the ones it could not draw are stated as a limitation
the bibliography is the tree's own sources, each with the sentence that supports the claim
the handoff and the report are two documents off one tree - continuity versus publication
the code repository link in the report, when this machine cannot authenticate
artifacts too large for a git host go to a Kaggle dataset, and the report carries the URL
